title: 12th Annual Hot Wheels Collectors Convention
summary: The 12th Annual Hot Wheels Collectors Convention took place in Anaheim, CA, in October 15–19, 1998. This is the first convention to offer Code 1 Hot Wheels models, with all previous models being Code 2 and Code 3 models. The guest of honor at the Convention was Ira Gilford.

title: Premium Collector Set
summary: The Premium Collector Set assortment is an adult collector-focused premium set consisting of 4 vehicles in diorama-style packaging. All vehicles feature Real Riders wheels, diecast bodies and chassis.
